# Base16

Base16 brings the Base16 colour system to Obsidian with more than two hundred ready-made schemes. Schemes that carry both a dark and a light variant switch automatically with the app's mode. The Default Dark and Default Light schemes are used out of the box, and any other is selected through the Style Settings plugin.

![Base16 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snelling-a/obsidian-base16/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Base16"
    author: "snelling-a"
    repo:   "snelling-a/obsidian-base16"
    slug:   "base16"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/base16"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/snelling-a/obsidian-base16"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snelling-a/obsidian-base16/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply the Base16 color system across Obsidian with 200+ ready-made color schemes and automatic dark/light switching for schemes that include both variants. Use the Default Dark/Light out of the box or pick any scheme via Style Settings integration."
}
```
